core.title: 10 x 41 Brass Kick Plate, DJO KP-10x41-605

text.description_html:
10" x 41" Kick Plate

This 10" x 41" Kick Plate is made of .050" thick high quality solid brass. It has an polished brass finish. Packaged with matching brass mounting screws for easy installation.

Specifications of the 10" x 41" Polished Brass Kick Plate:

  • Material: Solid Brass
  • Finish: Polished Brass with Clear Anodizing
  • Plate Height: 10"
  • Plate Width: 41"
  • Plate Thickness: .050" (1.2 mm)
  • Packaged with mounting screws.

Made to order. NOT Returnable.
